algorithm.lag: estimated once from the nominal trajectory by the same smooth-continuation + strict-ZOH polish as the deterministic estimator, then frozen for every Monte Carlo pattern
algorithm.physical_parameters: 13-D strict-ZOH least-squares solve at fixed lag for each perturbed spline, initialized from the nominal solution
algorithm.spline_knot_spacing: selected once by nominal blocked CV, then frozen; each Monte Carlo pattern refits only spline coefficients

noise_model.position: independent additive Gaussian noise at every estimator pose observation; equal x/y/z sigma
noise_model.rotation: independent right-multiplicative SO(3) rotation-vector Gaussian noise at every estimator pose observation; equal local x/y/z sigma
